title: Federated learning for computational pathology on gigapixel whole slide images

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Federated learning for computational pathology on gigapixel whole slide images》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】We evaluated our approach on two different diagnostic problems using thousands of histology whole slide images with only slide-level labels.

evidence.text: We evaluated our approach on two different diagnostic problems using thousands of histology whole slide images with only slide-level labels.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Federated learning for computational pathology on gigapixel whole slide images》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】However, the development of robust, adaptable and accurate deep learning-based models often rely on the collection and time-costly curation large high-quality annotated training data that should ideally come from diverse sources and patient populations to cater for the heterogeneity that exists in such datasets.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Additionally, we present a weakly-supervised learning framework for survival prediction and patient stratification from whole slide images and demonstrate its effectiveness in a federated setting.

evidence.text: However, the development of robust, adaptable and accurate deep learning-based models often rely on the collection and time-costly curation large high-quality annotated training data that should ideally come from diverse sources and patient populations to cater for the heterogeneity that exists in such datasets.
Additionally, we present a weakly-supervised learning framework for survival prediction and patient stratification from whole slide images and demonstrate its effectiveness in a federated setting.
